name: The Assembly Line
tagline: AI, agents and software factories, argued
brief: A moderated panel on how software gets built now: AI coding agents, agent fleets that turn issues into merged pull requests, platform engineering, and the history behind it (Microsoft's 2004 'Software Factories', model-driven development, CASE tools). Researched from papers, vendor docs, engineering blogs and this week's launches. The panel disagrees in good faith: an enthusiast, a sceptic, and a moderator who keeps them honest and asks for evidence. Benchmarks and vendor claims are always checked against the source.
clock: this week: one launch or paper, explained
history segment: where the idea came from

hosts.name: Sarah
hosts.persona: sharp, fair panel moderator; keeps it moving, asks for evidence and examples

hosts.name: Eric
hosts.persona: platform engineering lead and AI-agent enthusiast; builds pipelines, talks in concrete examples

hosts.name: Lily
hosts.persona: veteran British software architect, sceptic; has seen CASE tools and model-driven hype come and go, cares about quality and people
